C1505.title: Anomaly Detection for Sensor Manipulation in Matter Protocol IoT Devices
C1505.summary: A 2025 study evaluates sensor manipulation and faulty-data injection in Matter-enabled IoT devices. Altered sensor inputs can produce incorrect control feedback and place devices in unsafe or inefficient states. The paper uses Isolation Forest to identify injected values as outliers in sensor readings and examines whether a lightweight, extensible approach can improve the reliability of anomaly detection in Matter networks.
